Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Deck Name : Seterpenre's Dreamland
Author : Juggernaut1981
Description :
This is a deck I'm planning to use at the Bruce Cup. It's a "yoink and bleed" deck where I plan to try tap out my prey with their own minions (with the Temptations) and then bleed them out with Dream World. It isn't supposed to be a Tier 1 deck, but a deck for fun with a trick (And the multi-acting Seterpenre + Minion-borrowing with Dream World). If people have other wacky but plausible tricks, I'd be curious to hear suggestions, particularly if they involve Seterpenre (He seems to be abusable but I haven't figured out quite how yet...)

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Playing Seterpenre only with 2 skills seems a bit underpowered. Why not add 2 Dominate skills and replace Mental Maze by Obedience (plus, you can also play some bounce instead of some Ectasy and Confusion of the Eye)? Mental Maze is not very effective with the rest of your crypt...

I would also some (maybe 2) Psychic Veil that work well with multiacting and also Dream World.

I wouldn't play Shambling. You don't have enough allies to discard so they can see play.

The Bowl without any wake card is too predictable and too restrictive. Either remove it or add some wakes (the later being a good option).

No Opium Den? It's a card-saver.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Mental Maze works against allies while Obedience works against rush even when not blocking - I'd say that they are kinda comparably good for Setites (since Mental Maze doesn't cost them blood).

Messages.Author: KoKo
Messages.Body: Why Seterpenre and not Ogwon? There's the nec allies but the deck would be stronger without them IMHO with a cheaper crypt and 6 more master slots instead of discipline cards.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Please read the caveat at the beginning... it's supposed to be more of a trick deck for a fun tourney and it feels a little sleaze-bleed as it is. I was originally planning to play a Puppeteer but there are surprisingly few ways to reduce another minion's capacity unless they are titled or you are playing Baali (Barrenness and I'm SURE I don't own enough of THOSE).
